mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as input costs rise and margins compress.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth declines by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS m-o-m growth < -100,000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a high-inflation, tight monetary policy environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy further.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS y-o-y growth < -5.0% AND UNRATE 3-mo change > 0.5pp
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
